sourceVersionStatus: Pinned 2019 prelaunch Classic repository snapshot. Not independently verified against the August 2019 launch client. Later-expansion assets also exist in this tree; selected spell/item names are matched to Classic tooltip API.
preservation: Original PNG bytes downloaded untouched and checked against Git blob SHA-1. No redraw, cropping, upscale, AI generation, or image editing.
mappingVersionStatus: Mappings from current Wowhead Classic tooltip API; validates icon identity, not 2019 gameplay values. Spell ranks can share a single icon.
copyright: World of Warcraft art is Blizzard Entertainment property; source mirror does not establish a redistribution license.

class.verification: Visually inspected original class glyph atlas.

race.verification: Visually inspected original race portrait atlas. These are standard race portraits, not personalized player character renders.
